summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K on 17 September 2026 furnishing its audited financial results for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026, equivalent to a US annual report disclosure by a foreign private issuer. Highlights include a US$6.2 million Department of War Title III Defense Production Act investment, completion of the Pilot Mountain Pre-Feasibility Study showing after-tax NPV of US$660.3 million and 59.6% IRR, an upgraded S-K 1300 Mineral Resource Estimate, US$89.3 million total equity fundraisings including a US$68.3 million NYSE American IPO, and property/water-rights acquisition at Tempiute. No special-situation transaction terms were disclosed; routine annual reporting.
